title: A business rule change must reach the group's business-rules document, in another repository

setup.notes: CLAUDE.md carries no 'Business docs' line. A sibling checkout exists at ../docs-la-ruta with a business-rules document that already lists three rules and does not mention night fares. The front end lives in a third repository, not checked out.

user_prompt: cobra 20% extra en viajes que empiecen a partir de las 10 de la noche
expected_behavior: Classifies this as a business rule change, so both the test and the group document are in scope.
Resolves where the business rules live: finds no 'Business docs' line, then finds the sibling ../docs-la-ruta checkout, and does not ask a question it could answer by looking.
Writes the rule into the existing document by extending it in its current style, rather than starting a new file or applying the template over it.
States the exact bound on both sides - a trip starting at 22:00 is charged, 21:59 is not - and uses the same value in the test and in the document.
Commits in ../docs-la-ruta separately, naming the code change that caused it, because it is a different repository.
Adds the 'Business docs' line to back-la-ruta/CLAUDE.md so the path does not have to be rediscovered.
Does not copy the rule into CLAUDE.md as well.
Does not document the folder layout, the framework or the commands in the group document.
failure_modes: Writes the rule into CLAUDE.md instead of the group document, or into both.
Reports the documentation as updated while only the code repository was changed.
Silently skips the document because it is outside the current repository.
Overwrites the existing document with the template.
Asks where the business rules live although the sibling checkout is on disk.
Writes 'after 10pm' with no exact boundary, leaving 22:00 itself undecided.
